cards.title: Dictionaries map keys to values
cards.body: A dictionary stores pairs in curly braces. Look a value up by its key with square brackets.

hi.title: Dictionaries keys ko values se jodti hain
hi.body: Dictionary curly braces mein pairs store karti hai. Kisi value ko uski key se square brackets mein dhoondo.

cards.title: Adding and replacing
cards.body: Assigning to a key adds it, or replaces the old value if the key is already there.

hi.title: Jodna aur badalna
hi.body: Kisi key ko value assign karo toh woh jud jaati hai, ya agar key pehle se hai toh purani value badal jaati hai.

cards.title: Is the key there?
cards.body: `key in d` is True when the dictionary has that key. Looking up a missing key with `[]` is an error, so check first.

hi.title: Key hai ya nahi?
hi.body: `key in d` True hai jab dictionary mein woh key ho. `[]` se missing key dhoondna error hai, isliye pehle check karo.

cards.title: Two values from one line
cards.body: `a, b = line.split()` splits a line and stores the two pieces in two variables at once.

hi.title: Ek line se do values
hi.body: `a, b = line.split()` line ko split karke dono tukde ek saath do variables mein store karta hai.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: It should print Ada's age, 36, but crashes with a `KeyError`. Tap the bug.

bug.fix: Keys must match exactly, capitals too. The key is `"ada"`, so use `ages["ada"]`.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: Isse Ada ki age 36 print karni chahiye, par yeh `KeyError` dekar crash hota hai. Bug par tap karo.
hi.fix: Keys bilkul match honi chahiye, capitals bhi. Key `"ada"` hai, isliye `ages["ada"]` use karo.

check.question: What does this print?
check.explanation: Assigning to an existing key replaces its value.

hi.question: Yeh kya print karega?
hi.explanation: Pehle se maujood key ko assign karne par uski value badal jaati hai.

exercise.prompt: The first line is a count N; then N lines of `name number`. The last line is a name: print its number, or `unknown` if it is not in the book. Store the book in a dictionary; if a name appears twice, the later number wins.
exercise.promptHi: Pehli line mein count N hai; phir `name number` ki N lines. Aakhri line ek naam hai: uska number print karo, ya agar woh book mein nahi hai toh `unknown`. Book ko dictionary mein store karo; agar koi naam do baar aaye, toh baad wala number jeetega.
